name: 럭키
light: In a bright rose-white wellness atrium, front three-quarter standing pose, empty open hands relaxed apart. Rounded pink and cream slim armor plates, an oval pearl inset on the abdominal plate echoing the egg pouch, small soft fin-shaped hair ornaments. Clearly adult human woman, entire head and feet inside frame.
casual: Inside a bright craft-room in late morning, sewing a small cream fabric pouch with a blunt needle, one hand holding its side while the other draws a thread gently, both hands separate and visible, rose-colored notions in background.
Opaque pink sleeveless tailored crop blouse with a shallow V neckline and broad straps, cream high-waisted skirt below crop. Bare arms shoulders and small midriff, tiny oval pearl pendant.

In an empty fashion showroom under warm late-evening lamps, lightly leaning against a cream dressing console while fastening a small pearl bracelet on one wrist, both hands clearly readable at waist height. No mirror or reflections.

Opaque fully lined blush satin corset-style evening camisole with secure wide straps and cream lace trim over opaque fabric, matching high-waisted tailored satin shorts with scalloped opaque hems. Bare arms shoulders and legs; tiny oval pearl earrings.

At a quiet orchard picnic path on a crisp autumn afternoon, walking carefully with a shallow wicker basket of berries held at waist level by both handles, both hands visible apart, complete woman and shoes visible beneath golden trees.
Opaque cream sleeveless wrap mini dress with secure pink waist tie, fitted neckline and lined skirt, rose walking sandals, tiny oval pocket ornament. Bare shoulders arms upper chest and legs.
